item.title: Bloomington braces for CFP championship crowds and celebrations
item.description: Bloomington is preparing for a large influx of fans to celebrate the Indiana Hoosiers' College Football Playoff National Championship game against the Miami Hurricanes, with increased police presence, extended shifts, and added staff and security at local businesses. Students have the holiday without classes, and extreme low temperatures are expected outdoors.

item.title: 43 animals rescued from ‘toxic’ living conditions; Evansville duo face 100+ charges
item.description: Joshua and Alee Nelson were arrested in Evansville on 106 animal neglect charges after police found 43 animals living in squalid conditions with no access to food or water.

item.title: Gary proposes 3 sites for new Chicago Bears stadium
item.description: Gary officials have proposed three sites for a new Chicago Bears stadium. They say local, county, and state leaders support Gary's efforts. Hammond and possible Portage may also have sites for a new Bears stadium in Indiana. A bill has been introduced in the Indiana legislature to establish a northwest Indiana stadium authority to coordinate funding for any Indiana stadium.
